incidence_degree.note: The number of members of an arbitrary finite family F : {set {set T}} containing v, on any finType; no edge, uniformity or nonemptiness premise. The empty family and empty members count nothing, a singleton member counts once at its vertex, the count is at most #|F|, monotone in F and subtractive on subfamilies; restricted to the members inside W it is zero outside W and the full count for W = setT. At E(G) it is #|N(v)| (GTBase.common.incidence_degree_edges).
